# Checklist, writing and interpretation

What to verify before submitting, and how to report a curve honestly once it
survives that check.

::: {.callout-warning}
Draft. The section structure below is fixed and matches the class; the prose is
being written.

Every `##` section gets its own figure, as in Chapter 1. One H2 is one slide, so
the figure is also that slide's visual, and a section without one leaves the
deck with a blank.
:::

The checklist comes first: run it before writing a word, since every item is
something a reviewer can check and you cannot fix after submission. The writing
sections then say how to put the result on the page without claiming more than
it earned. The two were separate classes until 2026-10-20.

## Before extraction

Protocol registered, dose metric declared, reference handling decided.

## After extraction

Viability check run, doses harmonised, covariance inputs complete.

## Model specification

Functional form justified, knots declared, two-stage versus one-stage defended.

## Reporting the fit

What numbers belong in the paper, and in what units.

## The figure

Exposure range, confidence band, reference point, and what not to extrapolate.

## Common failures

The errors found most often in the published audit, each with the fix.

## Writing the methods

The sentences that have to be there: covariance handling, functional form, knots,
and the model class.

## Writing the results

Reporting a shape rather than a number, and giving effects at specific doses
that readers care about.

## Making claims the curve supports

Interpolation inside the observed range is fair. Extrapolation beyond it is the
single most common over-reach.

## Thresholds and optimal doses

Why a visually obvious plateau is weaker evidence than it looks, and how to
phrase a threshold claim.

## Reading someone else as a critic

The Burden of Proof dispute [@burdenofproofconcerns2023] as a worked exercise in
spotting where modelling choices carry the conclusion.

## The discussion and its limits

Stating what the evidence cannot answer, and why that strengthens the paper.
